scope_warning: Trained on ALL 1,200 palms with no held-out set. This is an INFERENCE artifact, not an evaluation artifact. No performance number may be quoted from this model; performance numbers come only from run_real.py / run_v2.py (leave-one-parcel-out). Its output is a RELATIVE score for ranking, not a calibrated probability -- never present sigmoid(logit) as a '% chance of infection'.

census.note: most recent census valid for this horizon

task.output: relative logit for ranking; NOT a calibrated probability

columns.rank: 1 = highest risk, within the risk set only; empty otherwise
columns.in_risk_set: 1 if status was 'A' at this census and the palm is scorable
columns.status: A asymptomatic | S symptomatic | D dead | C censored
columns.logit: raw model output, monotone in risk, unitless. NOT a probability
columns.n_neighbours: graph degree at r = 1.5 x planting spacing
columns.n_sick_neighbours: neighbours with status S or D at this census

prohibited_uses: Do not quote any performance metric from this file; the model has no held-out set.
Do not convert `logit` to a probability. It is uncalibrated.
Do not treat an empty score as low risk; those palms are already symptomatic, dead or censored.
